title: Synthetic build agent disk full
summary: Build failed because the worker disk had no space left for compiler output.
recommendation: Free disk space and investigate the worker's cleanup policy.

title: Synthetic worker out of memory
summary: A test worker was terminated after exhausting available memory.
recommendation: Inspect memory use and increase or rebalance worker capacity.

title: Synthetic unit test assertion regression
summary: A unit test failed with an assertion after a behavior regression.
recommendation: Review the changed behavior and update code or the intended assertion.

title: Synthetic missing Python dependency
summary: The test process failed with ModuleNotFoundError for a required package.
recommendation: Declare and install the missing dependency in the test environment.

title: Synthetic package registry timeout
summary: Dependency installation timed out while contacting the package registry.
recommendation: Retry after checking registry reachability and network latency.

title: Synthetic DNS resolution failure
summary: The worker could not resolve the hostname required by an integration test.
recommendation: Check DNS availability and the worker resolver configuration.

title: Synthetic unavailable runner image
summary: The build could not start because its requested runner image was unavailable.
recommendation: Restore the runner image or select an available image version.

title: Synthetic artifact service outage
summary: Artifact upload failed because the internal artifact service returned 503.
recommendation: Check artifact service health and retry after the outage is resolved.
